title: MFN2-Mediated MERCs Promote Odontoblast Differentiation and Dentinogenesis
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Odontoblasts are a tooth-specific cell type responsible for dentin formation. During odontoblast differentiation, dramatic organelle alterations occur with the increase of both mitochondria and endoplasmic reticulum (ER). In multiple cell types, ...
